hypothesis: The zero match is a short startup interval; moving every later DMA pixel is incorrect.
competitor: A uniform data pipeline delay explains both startup and later transitions; earlier failures were CPU read artifacts.
test: 1024 cases, finite Copper CLXCON gates with an INTREQR completion witness. Sweep opening or closing WAIT position4430..444e, pixels0/3, masks0040/C3, DPF and independent DDF/DIW controls. CPU reads only after the gate closes. Two independent hardware captures.

outcomes.uniform shift fits gated data and old tr: Retain full-stream placement only if strict neighbor cases also pass.
outcomes.startup gate differs while later transit: Model startup gating separately; reject blanket retiming.
outcomes.witness or repeats fail: Repair the probe before deriving a timing rule.

next_question: What comparator interval is visible independently of CPU destructive-read timing?

coverage.meaning: Finite Copper list reached the marker after closing the collision gate

measurements.meaning: Latched collision inside the Copper-defined gate

hardware.limitations: PAL A500 stock68000,512KiB chip/512KiB slow, silicon revisions unconfirmed. Two-plane lores, finite Copper CLXCON gate, INTREQR bit2 completion witness; no sprites or blitter. WAIT words describe programmed intervals, not inferred electrical timestamps. CPU samples after gate close; no timing alignment.
